title: Palace orders probe of Aeta farmers quitclaim linked to Pax Silica

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang would look into reports that Aeta farmers in New Clark City were made to sign quitclaim agreements without fully understanding their contents, amid concerns over the possible displacement of indigenous communities in connection with the Philippines’ participation in the United States-led Pax Silica initiative. Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Sunday that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. would not allow any transaction to disadvantage Filipinos, as she cited the need to authenticate the document reportedly signed by an Aeta farmer using a thumbprint.
